name: Kazincbarcika (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kazincbarcika: a yellow and blue shield with fleurs-de-lis and a wavy stripe, supported by a lion and a horse, above a scroll inscribed KAZINCBARCIKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kazincbarcika arms with supporters and scroll
